The lowest titer in Table 2 is **574 mg L⁻¹ for geraniol** (strain HBQA7 → Sm29). It was produced by engineering a synthetic methylotrophic pathway and methanol utilization, in shake flask culture over 48 h, and is referenced as [25] (Table 2, page 9). Page 11 also reports this value as 574.12 mg L⁻¹.

This is lower than the next-lowest entries, isoprene (HBQA7 → IS-8, 780 mg L⁻¹, page 9) and (−)-α-bisabolol (HBQA7 → Sm30, 1256 mg L⁻¹, page 9).
